card.name: Linking words before hospitalization or death
card.fires_on: The small linking word right after phrases like "resulted", "may lead", "serious outcomes have" or "including", just before a list of severe outcomes such as hospitalization or death. It appears in warning text about serious adverse events.

modes.label: resulted in / lead to
modes.description: The linking word after a verb like resulted or lead, just before death or hospitalization.
modes.example: Many of these events were serious and some resulted<< in>> death.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about loss, such as lost, loss and death-like outcomes.
card.plain: It fires on the little word before a grim outcome such as death or hospitalization in a warning sentence.
